name: River Hill Summer 2014

venue.name: [River Hill High School](http://www2.hcpss.org/rhhs)
venue.details: Competition is in the cafeteria of the school.

information: The registration is $15 if registering online and $30 if registering at the door. All competitors will pay at the door and please be sure to bring exact change. Spectators will be admitted for free. This payment will help pay for lunch and snacks, which will all be provided. This money may potentially also go into prizes.
